title: Personnel Scheduling during the COVID-19 Pandemic: A Probabilistic Graph-Based Approach.
problem: The paper addresses the challenge of effective personnel scheduling during the COVID-19 pandemic, particularly in minimizing the risk of infection spread among employees while meeting organizational goals.
contribution: The paper formulates challenges in personnel scheduling during the COVID-19 pandemic using two Mixed Integer Non-linear Programming (MINLP) models and proposes a canonical genetic algorithm along with two commercial solvers to solve these problems.
method: The paper proposes a canonical genetic algorithm as well as two commercial solvers to solve the formulated MINLP models.
results: The results demonstrate that following the recommended occupancy and testing strategy reduces the risk of infection by 25-60% under different scenarios, with vaccination status and interaction rate being critical factors.
